_about: 30 s office-sourcing Reel (1080x1920), v2: a real person (licensed Adobe Stock footage of one actor) at his desk, standing up, walking his office, while his own voice (Lebanese Arabic, male, first person) tells the story. Hook → problem → solution → CTA (fill the form = your first month free) → last hook (then only 9 dollars a month; the live Play price is $8.99). Rendered by marketing/source/reel_office_v2.html.
dialect: You are a native Lebanese Arabic speaker from Beirut, telling his own story in an Instagram reel as a voice-over, talking to colleagues like a friend would. Speak natural, everyday Lebanese dialect (Levantine), never Egyptian and never Modern Standard Arabic; say ق as a glottal stop like Beirutis do. Sound like a real person talking to a friend: relaxed, warm, conversational rhythm, natural breaths and small pauses, a smile in the voice. Never theatrical, never a TV announcer. English words (ProHost, Premium, app, booking, request, shift, clinic, studio, meeting room, monthly, yearly) are said naturally in English, the way Lebanese professionals say them.

posts.persona: A Lebanese psychologist in his late 30s who rents out his own clinic by the hour on ProHost. Warm, honest, a little proud of the solution he found; talking to fellow therapists and coaches.

lines.style: Honest confession that hooks; a small sigh before 'فاضية'.
lines.text: كنت إدفع إيجار عيادتي كامل… وهيّي فاضية نُصّ النهار.
بين جلسة وجلسة، ساعات ضايعة… ومصاري عم تطير.
هلّق عم أجّرها بالساعة على ProHost، لـ psychologists و coaches متلي.

lines.style: Calm and confident: I'm in control.
lines.text: أنا بحدّد الوقت والسعر، والطلبات بتوصلني عَالواتساب.

lines.style: Turning to the viewer, a warm invitation; lift on 'أوّل شهر مجّاناً'.
lines.text: إذا عندك مكتب، عبّي الـ form اللي بالـ bio، وبيفعّلولك أوّل شهر مجّاناً.

lines.style: Light, confident last hook; land 'تسعة دولار' clearly.
lines.text: وبعد الشهر؟ بسّ تسعة دولار بالشهر… أقلّ من إيجار ساعة وحدة.
